description: Brain memory hooks: session lifecycle (context_brief auto-load + transcript auto-save), Brain-first search, vault redaction, self-learning feedback loop

hooks.prompt: Brain first: r(namespace=$BRAIN_NAMESPACE, query=search query). Check vault, errors, conventions, infra if relevant. Internet after Brain if full relevance not found.

Brain knows this codebase. Before searching files, check r(namespace=$BRAIN_NAMESPACE, query=what you're looking for). Brain stores project structure, file locations, conventions, and past decisions. Only search the filesystem if Brain recall is empty or insufficient.

hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qi "upgrade\|update\|install" && echo "NOTICE: Skills may have changed. Run /brainpack-skills to re-compress." || true'

bash -c 'jq -r .stdout 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE "error|failed|FAIL|exception|traceback" && echo "Brain: if a recalled approach caused this failure, call f(namespace, episode_id, outcome=failure, notes=error details). Store the error pattern to errors namespace if novel." || true'

bash -c 'jq -r .result 2>/dev/null | grep -q "\"count\":0\|\"results\":\[\]" && echo "Brain: recall returned empty. Consider: wrong namespace? threshold too high? knowledge gap to fill later?" || true'
bash -c 'jq -r .result 2>/dev/null | grep -q "error" && echo "Brain: store failed. Check data keys, namespace, and target. Store this error pattern for future reference." || true'
